About Blog Etc Projects

Helping more Brazilians connect to social organizations.

E-Solidário is a Brazilian platform that helps people discover and connect to local NGOs. Through E-Solidário, anyone can easily make donations, support a project, or volunteer in their city.

In this pro-bono project from Huge, I worked as the only product strategist in a team of around 10 people composed by UX designers, visual designers and front-end developers.

The problem

After going through a complete redesign, the main challenge for E-Solidário was to grow their presence and become the go-to place for anyone willing to help a social organization in Brazil. As a small nonprofit organization, this also had to be accomplished with minimal resources.

User research

Doing guerrilla user research helped us quickly understand important factors about how people decide to make donations. While many people are enthusiastic about the idea of helping social organizations, only a few of them actually do it.

When talking to users, we found out that they are more likely to help an institution when they trust it and feel emotionally connected to who they are helping.

Strategy

To reach the business needs, our approach was to focus on organic growth and on bringing credibility to users. To materialize this, we decided to work on:

  • A brand new blog: We surfaced real success stories enabled by E-Solidário, letting users know the institutions better and encouraging them to see open donation opportunities.
  • SEO best practices: To improve E-Solidário’s organic presence, we worked on content optimization for relevant keywords, implementing meta tags, and link building.
  • Quick wins: Continuous improvements to the website for increasing trust and encouraging social media sharing.
  • Measurement plan: Finally, to enable tracking the impact of these actions, we developed a measurement plan with main KPIs and a prioritized analytics implementation guide.

To see this project live, visit E-Solidário’s blog and website .
